name: obsidian-bamboo-china
description: Bamboo China — a native, minimal Obsidian theme.
author: 羽鳞君

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-mood-tokens.mjs && sass src/theme.scss theme.css --no-source-map --style=compressed && npx --yes csso-cli theme.css --output theme.css && node scripts/verify-mood-parity.mjs
scripts.build:min: node scripts/gen-mood-tokens.mjs && sass src/theme.scss theme.css --no-source-map --style=compressed && npx --yes csso-cli theme.css --output theme.css && node scripts/verify-mood-parity.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/check-css.mjs && node scripts/check-palette-contrast.mjs && node scripts/check-a11y.mjs && node scripts/check-size.mjs
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run deploy
scripts.sync: npm run build:min && npm run deploy
